articles.title: 12-nation military exercise PRAGATI 2026 kicks off in Meghalaya, focus on counter-terror ops, regional cooperation
articles.summary: Multilateral military exercise PRAGATI 2026 has commenced at Umroi Military Station, Meghalaya. Indian Army troops are participating alongside forces from 12 other countries in this two-week joint exercise. The drill focuses on enhancing interoperability, cooperation, and collective response capabilities among participating nations, strengthening regional security ties. This significant event aims to prepare forces for complex, multinational operational environments.

articles.title: APAC Data Center Construction Market Investment to Reach USD 83.88 Billion by 2031, China Commands 53% Power Capacity, Followed by Southeast Asia 16.65%. | Arizton
articles.summary: Arizton has released an industry analysis report, announced from Chicago, forecasting regional outlook, growth potential, price trends, and competitive market share for an unspecified sector from 2026 to 2031. This research provides crucial insights into future market dynamics, valuable for understanding economic shifts and strategic planning. The report's scope covers a five-year projection period.

articles.title: Iran Consolidating Control of Hormuz With Checkpoints, Vetting and Sometimes ‘Fees’
articles.summary: A tanker crew courageously navigated a challenging, Iran-designated route through a critical strait, meticulously hugging the coastline and passing island checkpoints. This intricate transit underscores the geopolitical complexities and potential maritime security risks in key waterways, demanding high skill and bravery from seafarers operating in regions influenced by Iran.

articles.title: Arcfield awarded $75M follow-on contract to continue work on the U.S. Navy Combat Control Systems Program
articles.summary: Arcfield, a key government services provider, secured an award to deliver advanced, cutting-edge capabilities for undersea warfare operations. This initiative is crucial for enhancing national defence by integrating sophisticated technology into critical maritime domains, bolstering the nation's strategic military objectives and mission support.

articles.title: Russia’s Next Generation Fighter Jet Su-57D. Two-seater Version for India. Moscow-Delhi Defense Partnership
articles.summary: On May 17, Russia revealed its Su-57D two-seater, the latest variant of its next-generation fighter jet, now undergoing flight testing. This two-seater design implies enhanced capabilities for command, pilot training, or drone control. The development highlights Russia's continuous advancements in air superiority technology, impacting global military aviation and future defence strategies.

articles.title: Southwest Airlines inaugurates first India GCC in Hyderabad, to hire over 1000 employees
articles.summary: US airline giant Southwest Airlines has launched its first India Global Innovation Centre (GIC) in Hyderabad. This initiative underscores India's increasing prominence as a global technology hub, attracting multinational firms. The GIC will focus on advancing technology and engineering capabilities, contributing to India's tech ecosystem, generating employment, and strengthening its position as a preferred destination for innovation and talent.

articles.title: Markiplier's horror smash hit Iron Lung is streaming soon — here's when you can watch it at home
articles.summary: The popular horror film 'Iron Lung,' following a successful theatrical run, is now slated for an exclusive streaming release on YouTube Movies. This move allows fans to access the critically acclaimed title digitally, marking its anticipated home viewing debut. The YouTube exclusive release reflects current trends in digital film distribution.

articles.title: FIMER Announces Strategic Partnership With Redington Solar To Strengthen Pan India Distributor Network
articles.summary: FIMER India and Redington Solar (a Redington Limited subsidiary) have inked a pan-India distribution agreement for solar inverters. This strategic partnership is poised to significantly strengthen and reshape India's solar energy distribution network, enhancing the accessibility and deployment of critical solar technology nationwide. Such initiatives are crucial for India's sustainable energy goals.
